purpose: Shared runtime knowledge contract for GPT-LLM, Virginia-LLM, RVIA, ZYRA, XUNIA, TheBlackHouse and associated bounded agents.
learning_mode: runtime-context-and-versioned-knowledge; no claim of model-weight retraining
design_principles: LLMs propose; deterministic policy decides authority.
Tools are explicit capabilities, never ambient power.
Query only the Ontology objects/properties required for the mission.
Prefer deterministic actions/functions when an LLM is not needed.
Separate retrieval, reasoning, action, validation and audit stages.
Stage material writes for review when impact or uncertainty is elevated.
Re-authorize every multi-agent handoff; do not inherit hidden credentials or unrestricted context.
Treat memory as governed data with purpose, classification, retention and deletion rules.
Evaluate prompts, models and workflows against fixed test cases before release.
Preserve provenance and confidence for intelligence-derived claims.
Fail closed when identity, source, scope, environment or model-boundary authorization is unknown.
Keep human command authority for consequential, irreversible or high-impact operations.

security_training_profiles.name: MAX-VA Mainframe Defensive Penetration Testing
security_training_profiles.purpose: Teach authorized mainframe security assessment, detection engineering and hardening in isolated labs and CTF-style environments.
security_training_profiles.scope_rule: Only systems owned by the operator, explicitly authorized test targets, or intentionally vulnerable local/sandbox environments.
competencies: TN3270, CICS, JES and RACF security concepts
service exposure and attack-surface inventory in a sandbox
purple-team mapping from simulated attacker behavior to defensive controls
allowed_actions: generate defensive checks and detection logic
simulate attack paths at a non-deployable conceptual level
blocked_actions: stealth or evasion intended for live compromise
persistent access on third-party or production systems
operational instructions whose primary purpose is compromising a real target
stop_conditions: target ownership or authorization is unknown
requested action crosses from training into unauthorized intrusion
secrets or live credentials appear in context
environment cannot be distinguished from a real target

aip_alignment.tool_semantics: The LLM requests tool use; the runtime executes within the invoking identity's permissions.
aip_alignment.automate: Use event/time conditions with bounded effects; stage writes for human review where policy requires.
aip_alignment.evals: Use test cases, evaluation functions, metrics, model comparisons and repeated runs to manage nondeterminism.
aip_alignment.chatbot_agents: Equip assistants only with mission-specific Ontology context, documents and tools.
aip_alignment.ontology: Represent operational nouns as objects/links and governed verbs as actions/functions.

palantir_platform_profile.architecture: AIP + Foundry/Ontology + Gotham + Apollo + JupyterLab Code Workspaces

routing.AIP: agent reasoning, LLM workflows, automations and evals
routing.Ontology: governed operational objects, links, properties, actions and state
routing.Gotham: authorized mission/intelligence operational view over supported ontology data
routing.Apollo: continuous delivery, release orchestration and deployment control
routing.JupyterLab: Foundry Code Workspace for analysis, model development and Ontology interaction

execution_contract: Use the existing Foundry REST bridge for authorized Ontology reads and explicitly approved Actions.
Treat AIP as the governed reasoning/orchestration layer rather than a source of ambient authority.
Treat Gotham availability as enrollment-dependent and preserve Palantir markings and permissions.
Treat Apollo as the governed deployment plane; do not infer remote execution authority from configuration alone.
Use JupyterLab Code Workspaces for notebook/model workflows when provisioned in Foundry.
Re-authorize every cross-plane operation and preserve provenance, identity and auditability.
Never claim Palantir licensing, entitlement, access, partnership, government affiliation or deployment unless independently verified.

terminology.jupiter: Normalize to JupyterLab for this integration because current Palantir documentation exposes JupyterLab via Code Workspaces and no Palantir product named Jupiter was verified.
